name: Marine Products Corporation
summary: Marine Products Corporation (MPC) is a global manufacturer specializing in recreational fiberglass powerboats, catering to the sportboat, sport fishing, and jet boat sectors. The company's diverse product line includes Chaparral brand pleasure boats, offered as sterndrive models like the SSi Sport Boats, SSX Sport Boats, and Surf Series, as well as outboard variants such as the OSX Luxury Sportboats and other SSi and SSX outboard configurations. Additionally, MPC produces Robalo outboard sport fishing boats, a brand that also encompasses center and dual console vessels, alongside Cayman Bay Boats. Its products reach customers through an expansive distribution network, consisting of 206 independent authorized dealers across the United States and 92 operating internationally. Marine Products Corporation, founded in 1965, maintains its headquarters in Atlanta, Georgia.
